name: Drive-In Double Feature
description: Park the Chevy and turn up the speaker: 1950s and 60s drive-in fodder with hot rods (Hot Rod Girl, Dragstrip Girl, The Fast and the Furious), juvenile delinquents (The Violent Years, Teenage Doll, Girls Town), bikers (Hells Angels on Wheels, The Glory Stompers), beach parties, jungle adventures and Ed Wood-adjacent oddities like Glen or Glenda and The Wild Women of Wongo. Sword & Sandal Saturday brings Hercules and friends at 9:00 pm.
curated: 2026-10-15: about 67 hours of hand-picked 1938-1969 drive-in features (JD, hot rod, biker, beach, jungle, peplum and oddball programmers); sci-fi and horror titles left to Atomic Age and Shock Theater, Film_Noir-collection titles (Jail Bait, High School Big Shot, Five Minutes to Live) left to the noir channel, and MST3K riffs, trailers, colorized copies, split-reel uploads and sexploitation (Liane, Girl on a Chain Gang) excluded.
